compiler.validation: test-inventory compiler command and mncs-test live runner pass

evidence.summary: The compiler emits deterministic declaration identities, source spans, profile, subject identity, and test-case identity.
The native self-suite has no per-test [[tests]] entries and no handwritten suite aggregation.

reproduction.instructions: Run mncs test-inventory on a Profile 0.17 source target, then run mncs-test without per-test manifest entries.

summary: Compiler-owned static inventory replaces recursive filesystem discovery for ordinary first-class tests. The runner accepts a source/module target; recursive filesystem enumeration remains only for explicitly declared project/library roots and legacy fixture discovery.

workaround.description: Python still walks explicitly named library/fixture roots for transport and compatibility concerns; it does not scan MNCS source to discover test declarations.
